description: This file defines various template metaprogramming utilities and type traits within the WPEFramework namespace, including pick, func_traits, enable_if, and detection macros for member functions, static functions, and template functions.

classes.name: pick
classes.description: Template struct to select a type from a parameter pack based on an index.

classes.name: func_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract traits from various function types, including member functions, function pointers, and std::function.

classes.name: same_or_inherits
classes.description: Template struct to check if two types are the same or one inherits from the other.

classes.name: sign
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type is signed.

classes.name: IS_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to detect if a member function with a specific signature exists in a type.

classes.name: IS_MEMBER_AVAILABLE_INHERITANCE_TREE
classes.description: Macro to detect if a member function exists anywhere in the inheritance tree of a type.

classes.name: IS_STATIC_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to detect if a static member function with a specific signature exists in a type.

classes.name: IS_TEMPLATE_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to detect if a template member function with a specific signature exists in a type.
